svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to find your BitLocker recovery key: From checking
the key ID to your account and printed copy
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-06
First, write down the first 8
characters of the key ID on the…
The recovery screen shows a key ID paired with
the recovery key.
Step 1: Find it in your Microsoft
account
On a browser on another device, go to
https://aka.ms/myrecoverykey and sign in with
the same Microsoft account.
Step 2: Find it in your work or school
account
If you have ever signed in to the PC with a work
or school account, the key may be stored in the
organization's account.
Step 3: Check printed copies, USB
drives, and text files
You may have printed the key or saved it to a
USB drive or text file when enabling BitLocker.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
